items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Then joined Vernon Andrade's at the Renaissance.

ctx.x: But Zutty that was after you came out of Connie's Inn wasn't it?
Well according to this you know, after you came out of Connie's Inn with Ally Ross you had your own band at the La Fayette. Then joined Vernon Andrade's at the Renaissance.

That's right. That's right, yes. And right after the Renaissance I went to Chicago. I went to Philadelphia with Norman and Arlene Selby. She used to do a Louise Cook dance and he made up black face.....
